title: ConnectFour
body:
# ConnectFour GUI 1vs1 Minigame This plugin adds a fully interactive **Connect Four (Four in a Row)** minigame using a GUI. Players can challenge each other **for fun** or **for in-game money**. ![ShowCase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79d6a2c0a10a238078b82e9bf2f15690418fe4ed.png)
Showcase Video

Supports any bukkit platform from 1.8 up to 1.21.10 ### Features: - GUI - Bets - Leaderboard - Player stats - Placeholders - Rich configuration - Configurable messages (supports hex colors) ### Commands/Permissions: | Command | Description | Permission | |-----------------------------|:--------------------------:|---------------------:| | /connectfour | Shows a help menu | - | | /cf invite [bet] | Invite a player for a game | - | | /cf bet | Make a bet with a player | - | | /cf accept | Accepts players invite | - | | /cf reject | Accepts players invite | - | | /cf stats [player] | Show stats of player | - | | /cf leaderboard | Show win leaderboard | - | | /cf reload | Reloads config & messages | connectfour.reload | ### Placeholders: - %connectfour_wins% - %connectfour_losses% - %connectfour_draws% - %connectfour_played% - %connectfour_winrate% - %connectfour_totalbet%
